322:   def pbBattleLoop
323:     @turnCount = 0
324:     loop do   # Now begin the battle loop
325:       PBDebug.log("")
326:       PBDebug.log_header("===== Round #{@turnCount + 1} =====")
327:       if @debug && @turnCount >= 100
328:         @decision = pbDecisionOnTime
329:         PBDebug.log("")
330:         PBDebug.log("***Undecided after 100 rounds, aborting***")
331:         pbAbort
332:         break
333:       end
334:       PBDebug.log("")
335:       # Command phase
336:       PBDebug.logonerr { pbCommandPhase }
337:       break if @decision > 0
338:       # Attack phase
339:       PBDebug.logonerr { pbAttackPhase }
340:       break if @decision > 0
341:       # End of round phase
342:       PBDebug.logonerr { pbEndOfRoundPhase }
343:       break if @decision > 0
344:       @turnCount += 1
345:     end
346:     pbEndOfBattle
347:   end
